name: MusicContext
description: Music direction for AI agents: analyzes a video's cuts, narration and story, plans a timed soundtrack, generates music offline and renders the mix with FFmpeg. Local-first and sandboxed to the working directory. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Start the server from the intended project directory and pass musiccontext mcp --roots /path/to/project (or set MUSICCONTEXT_ROOTS); --roots adds allowed directories and the working directory stays reachable.
Set MUSICCONTEXT_LOCAL_ONLY=1 to refuse any provider that would send data off the machine; remote URL input is already off by default.
Keep musiccontext_generate and musiccontext_sync on review: they write new audio and video files, and sync can replace an existing output when force is true.
